direction.grid: 1366x768 first: 100vw x 100dvh shell, overflow hidden, no page scroll. grid-template-columns:184px minmax(0,1fr) 360px; grid-template-rows:48px 52px minmax(0,1fr) 56px; header spans all rows of columns, rail left, guide above stage, factory centre, inspector right, decision bar bottom centre+right. Factory stage >=55% width and >=60% height. Only inspector/task list may scroll internally.

colorTokens.held: neon outline + diagonal hatch + HELD label
colorTokens.blocked: silver dashed route + X marker + BLOCKED label
colorTokens.accepted: solid neon route + check + ACCEPTED label
colorTokens.logo: Use supplied logo asset once in header only, at native aspect on its black field; never recolor, redraw, crop, outline or duplicate it. Remove red/orange state colors.

direction.typography: System sans only for offline reliability. Stage title 24px/30px 700, panel title 15px/20px 650, body 13px/19px, micro-label 11px/14px 700 uppercase, metrics 26px tabular-nums. One verb-led instruction and one status sentence per screen; delete hero slogans, repeated mission text and recap banners from the working surface.
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out opacity/transform for panel and selection changes; one 240ms SVG route trace on state change, then static. No loops, parallax or decorative glow pulses. @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce): all transition/animation/dash/pulse removed; state shown instantly with hatch, dashes, icons and text. Focus ring appears instantly.

components.Header: 48px: immutable logo left, Forgefront Systems / FACTORY RESILIENCE, recovery state and HUMAN DECISION right; Lock recovery room as labelled header button.
components.StepRail: One rail rendered from the same supplied steps array as every header count. Real buttons, 36-40px high, completed/current/locked shown by icon + text + color; aria-current=step on current.
components.GuideStrip: 52px: Step X of Y from state, current instruction, primary action right. Replace vague Show next action with the actual verb for that step.
components.FactoryStage: Cinematic focusable inline SVG with title chip, legend and synced selection; every node is reachable and labelled.
components.EvidenceInspector: 360px task-specific panel: evidence comparison, options as radio groups, disruption control, task review or proof controls depending on step; required action never below the fold.
components.DecisionBar: 56px: Back left, required human action centre, primary next action right. Destructive/invalidating actions separated and text-labelled, never color-only.
components.Keyboard: Skip-to-stage first; tab order header > rail > guide > SVG nodes > inspector > decision bar; 2px neon focus outline + 2px offset; Arrow keys move in rail and SVG, Enter/Space activates, Esc closes drawers; aria-live=polite only for state results.

visualizations.FactorySVG: Inline SVG viewBox 0 0 960 540, cinematic side-elevation/isometric composition on black: receiving dock and held lot, QA/material-hold gate, conveyor, CELL-MILL-1 and CELL-MILL-2 as brushed-silver machine silhouettes, JOB-1001 and JOB-1002 order bays below. Silver idle strokes, neon only for accepted/feasible routes and primary highlights.
visualizations.StateBinding: Bind every node, route, badge and count to real state only: certificate mismatch holds MAT-ALLOY-A; JOB-1001 40 parts and JOB-1002 30 parts total 70 held-demand units; impacted jobs, feasible paths, cell online/offline, acceptance invalidated/accepted, event count and packet sealed change the SVG and inspector together. No decorative machines or unbound metrics.
visualizations.Evidence: Certificate vs Receiving as two aligned quantity tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; show quantities only when present in state. Selecting an SVG job/evidence node highlights the matching inspector row and vice versa.
visualizations.Legend: Persistent under stage: Running, Held, Blocked, Offline, Feasible/Accepted, each with distinct pattern, marker and text label.

fixes.change: Remove the duplicated logo and One bad cert hero from the right panel; open Certificate vs Receiving evidence there by default and make Inspect source evidence the DecisionBar primary.
Replace red rectangular boxes with the cinematic state SVG: Receiving held with hatch, both mill cells AWAITING DECISION, dashed blocked routes to JOB-1001 and JOB-1002.
Delete the second out-of-order Incident/Investigate/Decide/Shock/Project board/Proof nav; keep one rail from the steps array with aria-current=step and visible focus.

Bind investigation to the SVG: make ev-cert-qty, ev-recv-qty and ev-sub-stock focusable evidence nodes; selecting one highlights its route and inspector record, and a completed investigation traces the calculated recovery routes.
Compress the right panel to route label, one select, Check selected route as secondary, Investigate recovery as the only primary, and one status line; delete repeated offline explanations.
Expose the same route facts by keyboard: logical focus order, Enter/Space to investigate, aria-live=polite announcing only the investigation result.

Fit the decision in 768px: convert the three tall option cards to compact selectable radio rows comparing finish and incremental cost, and keep the APPROVE phrase input plus seal action visible in the inspector/DecisionBar without scrolling.
Link option selection to the factory: preview that option's feasible route and affected jobs on the SVG before acceptance; keep held/blocked states pattern-and-label based, not red-only.
Remove Revoke acceptance when the state is No acceptance recorded; show it only after a sealed acceptance exists.

Turn the prose task list into three distinct reviewable task cards before approval, each with task name, dependency, due state and linked JOB/CELL node; selecting a card highlights the accepted SVG path.

Compress Britt 4.0 to a slim proposal header and fit To do / In progress / Done as three compact columns or a segmented board within the stage height; move Approve/Decline to the DecisionBar with Approve primary.
Resolve the counters: distinguish Proposal untracked from tracked board work so 0 tracked does not appear to contradict a ready proposal.

Show the actual disruption task in the inspector at 768px: CELL-MILL-2 preselected as outage target, consequence text, and Simulate a machine outage as primary; do not let the project board occupy this step.

On application, immediately change header, footer and SVG from RECOVERY ACCEPTED to ACCEPTANCE INVALIDATED: CELL-MILL-2 OFFLINE cross-hatch, its routes dashed/blocked, and the next action changed to reinvestigation.
Freeze the existing task board as read-only context behind the invalidated banner instead of presenting Draft recovery tasks as the current action.

Replace the repeated shock-simulation panel with the reinvestigation panel: retain the previously selected route, show CELL-MILL-2 OFFLINE / CELL-MILL-1 ONLINE constraints, and make Run investigation the single primary.
Fix the outage target conflict: do not default the selector to CELL-MILL-1 after CELL-MILL-2 is already offline; disable an already-applied outage and label it APPLIED.
Add an original-vs-changed constraint comparison tied to the SVG, with only the CELL-MILL-1 route feasible and the CELL-MILL-2 route statically blocked under reduced motion.
Use the same compact radio-row comparison as Step 3 and keep the revised APPROVE input and acceptance action visible without inspector scrolling.

Make the change explicit on the options and SVG: Split available capacity changes from feasible to CONSTRAINED because it requires at least two online compatible cells; render it non-selectable with a focusable reason.
When an option is selected, preview its revised route through CELL-MILL-1 and dim the offline CELL-MILL-2 path with pattern and OFFLINE label, not red alone.

Resolve the state contradiction: the map says RECOVERY ACCEPTED and Approve Britt's proposal is active while a task says CELL-MILL-2 unavailable, fresh acceptance required. Gate Approve on one authoritative revised-acceptance state and align banner, board and buttons.
Fix numbering from one steps array: header Step 8 Britt replans must not coexist with rail items labelled 08 Verify and retain evidence and 09 Britt replans the recovery work.

Fit the board as To do / In progress / Blocked / Done segmented views or a compact 2x2 grid; selecting Verify accepted source records highlights CELL-MILL-1, JOB-1001 and JOB-1002 and shows why the CELL-MILL-2 dependency is blocked.

Replace the project-board inspector with the actual proof task: ledger verification status, 18-event hash-chain state, export action, separate passphrase field and independent-checkpoint retention instruction, all visible at 768px.
Remove the duplicate rail entry 10 Verify and retain evidence and derive header and rail totals from the same steps array.
Put Verify ledger and Export evidence packet in the DecisionBar; give the masked passphrase an aria-describedby strength/retention note and announce verification results via aria-live=polite only.
Reconcile completion numbering: header Step 9 of 9 Recovery story complete and rail 11 Recovery story complete must both be generated from the supplied steps array as the final step.
Keep the compact Before-After summary, but bring the retained-evidence passphrase completion and final export/retention action fully into the viewport instead of cutting them off below the fold.

Set the final SVG state deliberately: accepted route through CELL-MILL-1, CELL-MILL-2 OFFLINE labelled, both jobs linked to 18 EVENTS - PACKET SEALED; remove generic live-recovery wording that implies work is still undecided.
